data.title: Fix O(N^2) loops in CreateTruthLinks
data.author: davidlange6
data.body:
Three inner loops each iterated over all MCParticles to find non-zero entries, giving O(N_hits × N_particles) and O(N_cluster_hits × N_links) complexity.

primary changes: 1) Iterate simHitMapEnergy map keys directly instead of scanning all MCParticles for non-zero entries. 2)Build a cellID → links index (std::unordered_map) once after the calo-hit loop, then use O(1) lookup per cluster hit instead of a full scan of the link collection. 3) Iiterate mcpEnergy map keys directly instead of scanning all MCParticles per cluster.

BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Speedup O(N2) loops in CreateTruthLinks
ENDRELEASENOTES

comments.author: scott-snyder
comments.body: Did you check that results are unchanged?  (It looks like this would change the ordering of links?)

comments.author: davidlange6
comments.body: I did an element-by-element comparison of CaloHitMCParticleLinks and ClusterMCParticleLinks including their order. The intent is that using ordered maps should preserve results.

data.title: Use CTest fixtures for generated test data
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- CMake: Use CTest fixtures for generated test data in DDSim and the examples. Selecting a consumer automatically includes its producers, and failed setup skips consumers instead of producing secondary missing-file errors.
- CMake: Use a fixture for DDDB extraction and cleanup, and allow cleanup when the database is absent.

ENDRELEASENOTES

Fixtures are different from `DEPENDS` in that the tests won't run if their setup test wasn't successful, while `DEPENDS` only indicates that a test has to run after another one.

data.title: perf(dashboard): cache each nightly report parsed once per night, slot MetricVerdict and reduce region timing stats a frame at a time
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
## Summary

This PR improves dashboard performance by avoiding repeated loading and parsing of nightly regression reports, while also reducing memory usage and simplifying some of the data processing.

Previously, reports were cached as raw JSON and parsed independently by different dashboard tabs. Reports are now parsed once per night and cached as `NightlyReport` objects using `st.cache_resource`. This allows different tabs and overlapping date ranges to reuse the same parsed data without repeating the work.

The changes include:

- Cache parsed nightly reports individually, so extending a date range only requires fetching and parsing previously unseen nights.
- Update the Overview, Regressions, Stack Changes, and Trends tabs to work directly with the cached reports, removing re…

data.title: Shift the event position in GaussSmearVertex and FlatSmearVertex so that beam particles are smeared too
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- `GaussSmearVertex`, `FlatSmearVertex`: shift the event position together with the vertices, so that beam particles start at the smeared interaction point instead of (0,0,0). Fixes #63.

ENDRELEASENOTES

The smearing tools shifted each vertex in `GenEvent::vertices()`. The beam particles come out of the HepMC3 root vertex, whose position is the event position. The root vertex is not in that list, so the beams stayed at (0,0,0) while everything else moved. `GenEvent::shift_position_by` shifts the event position and all vertices. Vertices without an explicit position take theirs from the (shifted) event position or their parent vertex, so they end up where they were before.

data.title: fix(HepMC3EventReader): apply the length unit to the primary vertex position
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
-  HepMC3EventReader: apply the length unit to the primary vertex position

ENDRELEASENOTES

## Summary

Apply the HepMC3 event length unit when setting the primary vertex position in `HepMC3EventReader`.

The particle production/end positions are already converted using `len_unit`, and the vertex time is converted as well, but the `x`, `y`, and `z` coordinates of the corresponding `Geant4Vertex` were previously used without applying the HepMC3 length unit.

This is invisible for HepMC3 files using millimetres, but gives incorrect vertex positions for events using centimetres.

data.title: Fix CollectionMerger copy mode, empty inputs and exception safety
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - Fix CollectionMerger copy mode, reject empty inputs, and clean up the output when merging throws.

ENDRELEASENOTES

- `Copy=True` currently throws `Immutable objects can only be added to subset collections` (or the equivalent link error): `back_inserter` converts mutable clones to immutable handles. Insert clones directly to preserve the mutable handle.
- `InputCollections=[]` currently produces a null output that the writer dereferences, causing a segmentation fault. Reject this configuration during initialization because the output type cannot be inferred.
- Exceptions during merging, such as a type mismatch after the first input, currently leak the partially constructed output. Own it with `std::unique_ptr` until the merge succeeds.

data.title: Expand support for 4D tracking
data.author: jburzy
data.body:
Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`

### New properties

- `UseHitTimeInCKF`: adds the hit time as a third CKF measurement dimension (`eBoundTime`).
- `HitTimeResolutions`: per-sensor time resolutions (ns) as a map from `CellIDSelector` selection string to resolution, e.g. `{"system:1|2": 0.03, "system:3|4|5|6": 0.06}`. These are required when `UseHitTimeInCKF` or a seeding time cut is set, must be finite and > 0, must not overlap, and are a placeholder until EDM4hep stores a per-hit time error (key4hep/EDM4hep#527, a warning is printed when they are used).

data.title: GNNTrackFinding: drop the redundant edge deduplication
data.author: madbaron
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- GNNTrackFinding: drop the edge deduplication from the edge ordering (`unique_dim` in `OnnxMetricLearning::orderEdgesByDistance`) and from `CCAndWalkTrackBuilding`. Acts' edge building already leaves each pair of hits once, so neither ever removed an edge. The track building checks this in debug builds.
- The order of the edges handed to the classifiers and the order of the track candidates can change, so classifier scores may differ in the last bits; the set of candidates is otherwise unchanged.

ENDRELEASENOTES

Split out of #113.

ENDRELEASENOTES

Depends on #113.

data.title: Support the FieldMap based persistency from PandoraSDK v03
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
PandoraSDK changed in https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/PandoraSDK/pull/38 the object factory persistency interface to `Read(Parameters&, const FieldMap&)` / `Write(const Object*, FieldMap&)`, which breaks the build:

```
include/LCObjects/LCTrack.h:124:81: error: 'ReadVariable' is a private member of 'pandora::BinaryFileReader'
include/LCObjects/LCTrack.h:133:44: error: no member named 'ReadVariable' in 'pandora::XmlFileReader'
```

`LCTrackFactory` now uses the new interface when `Persistency/FieldMap.h` is available and keeps the old implementation otherwise, so it builds with both versions.

reviews.author: tmadlener
reviews.body: Looks good to me. I am not sure if we ever use persistency via Pandora in any case.
